To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the alignment between quality and business goals can be achieved by deriving requirements from quality goals and by prioritizing requirements and architectural decisions.

the alignment of software specifications with business goals is supported by the following activities: (1) the derivation of software quality requirements from quality goals; (2) the prioritization of software quality requirements; (3) the definition of decision-criteria for architectural design decisions.

the SIKOSAs methodology provides a structured way of deriving and prioritizing software requirements from quality- and business goals and a way of defining decision criteria for architectural decisions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the alignment of software specification activities with quality and business goals.
the alignment of architectural decisions with quality and business goals.
the alignment of software specifications with quality goals and business goals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SIKOSO methodology is an approach to align software specification with quality and business goals.
the SIKOS method is a method that is suitable for software development projects with a high level of quality requirements, which are also subject to business goals.
the SIKOSO methodology supports the alignment of software specifications with quality goals, and indirectly with business goals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a methodology which supports software engineers in making decisions during software development in order to align these decisions to quality goals, which in turn are aligned to business goals.
we have developed a methodology for the integrated assurance of software quality, which is based on a quality model, which supports the alignment of software specifications to business goals.
we have developed a method to align software specifications with quality goals and business goals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the alignment of software specifications with business goals is not a one-shot activity but rather a process which has to be supported by the methodology.
the alignment of software specifications to quality and business goals has to be performed at different levels of abstraction and in different phases of the software development process.
business goals are indirectly aligned with architectural decisions via software requirements and quality goals.
